label: It is possible for a cause to bring…, from It can be the case that some cause brings… and 1 more
meaning: Partial reconstruction of NecessaryBeing.com A7c steps 1–3. Under a primitive possible-causability predicate for situations with a cardinal lower bound, the two reader-reported premises yield the one-contingent possibility by four finite decrement instantiations; the bound result is a transcription by instantiation and closes nothing while its premises are open. This neither proves the reader's transfer report nor reaches a noncontingent cause, S5 modal upgrade or God. It introduces no new premise on the root path.
